svg.text: Each panel shows one rule and its text. Flows run from left to right. The first alternative stays on the main line, skip flows run above an item and back flows below it.
Symbol and sequence: task boxes in a row
Choice: a pair of exclusive gateways
Optional part: a skip flow above the item
One or more: a back flow below the item
Zero or more: a skip flow and a back flow
Bound: the loop marker with its numbers
Bound from 0: the skip flow and the numbers
Reference: a thick box with a drill-down marker
Reference to a rule for one step: a thick task box
Self tail call: a back edge to the start
refinement = "identifies a gap" "revises the solution" refinement? ;
Self tail call in a choice
Self tail call in a middle branch: a link with the loop sign
Loop through two rules: a link with the loop sign
Left recursion: a link with the loop sign
